## Domain analysis and decisions

### Assessment purpose scope and sample (`scope`)

Define the decision, participating units, sample method, and limits on generalization.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Framework and rating rubric (`rubric`)

Explain capability criteria, evidence strength, tailoring, and rating ceiling.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Evidence triangulation (`evidence`)

Compare interviews, documents, and operating records with dates and disagreements.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Current and business-required target (`current_target`)

Separate evidence-supported current state from business-justified target.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Disagreements and uncertainty (`uncertainty`)

Record sampling blind spots, weak evidence, and cases where one score is unjustified.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Improvement portfolio and roadmap (`roadmap`)

Prioritize actions by business impact, dependencies, cost, and readiness.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Communication reassessment and acceptance (`reassessment`)

Set result validation, owners, reassessment cadence, and completion evidence.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.
